section_summary.extract_value: This section details the statistical procedures used in the study, including correlation analyses to explore relationships among gratitude, loneliness, social desirability, subjective happiness, and life satisfaction. It also describes four-step hierarchical multiple regression analyses, with loneliness as the dependent variable, progressively adding gratitude, social desirability, well-being measures, and socio-demographic variables (gender, marital/relationship status, employment status, age, and education) as predictors. All analyses were performed using SPSS 16.0.
